content_of_post_to_answer: Hoe can I develop my personality?
answer: Personality is often treated as something you either have or lack, but it is mostly the result of repeated choices. A person becomes interesting by developing opinions, skills, curiosity, and the courage to express them. The overlooked part is that copying confident people rarely builds confidence; paying attention to your own experiences and forming your own responses does. A strong personality is not a performance for others—it is the visible result of knowing yourself.
